CustomField.description: Whether one model turn may request several tool calls. Core runs them one after another as a batch and returns all results to the model together.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: When checked, the model can request several independent tools in one turn; Core runs them in order and returns all results together, saving model calls. Uncheck when each tool needs the previous tool's result.
CustomField.label: Allow Multiple Tool Calls Per Turn
